::: {.tut-standfirst}
Saíra is an R package that opens a visual interface in your browser. This page shows how to install it and start the application for the first time.
:::

## Requirements

You need **R** installed (version 4.1 or later). RStudio is recommended but not required — any R console works. You don't need to know how to program: once installed, all the work happens through the graphical interface.

## Installing from GitHub

Saíra is not on CRAN yet; install the development version directly from the repository. Use `pak` (recommended) or `remotes`:

```r
# Option A — with pak (resolves dependencies automatically)
install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("rogerio-onza/saira")

# Option B — with remotes / devtools
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("rogerio-onza/saira")
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## The first installation takes a while
Saíra depends on several packages (Shiny, spreadsheet readers, taxonomic and geographic backbones). The first installation may take a few minutes while those dependencies are downloaded and compiled.
:::

## Opening the application

With the package installed, a single line opens the interface in your browser:

```r
library(saira)
saira::run_app()
```

The app opens in a new tab. From there, everything is done through menus, buttons and tables.

::: {.callout-warning}
## The window didn't open?
On servers or environments without a default browser, `run_app()` prints a local address (something like `http://127.0.0.1:xxxx`). Copy that address and open it manually in your browser.
:::

## Language

Saíra is bilingual. In the top corner of the interface you can switch between **Portuguese (PT-BR)** and **English (EN-US)** at any time — useful for mixed teams or for publishing metadata in English.
